[[File:Mandalorian_Stimshot_FLT.png|thumb|right|250px|A Mandalorian warrior administers a stim-shot.]]
A '''stim-shot''', also known as a '''stimshot''', was a [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulant]] administered with a pneumatic dispenser. They were often carried by field [[Medic/Legends|medics]].

Stim-shots, along with [[adrenaline booster]]s, were used to keep a patient alert and stop them from going into shock. They were commonly found in [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]]. Stim-shots could also be released directly into a [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tank]], or injected into the patient using retractable [[hypospray]]s.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
